title: Jubilant French Chicken Tagine
description: A floral and aerated French dish featuring beer and cooked in a tagine style, perfect for a hangover cure, this recipe is sugar free friendly and made in a fondue pot. It combines the flavors of chicken, beer, and spices to create a delicious and comforting meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the fondue pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken breast pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the beer, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve the chicken and sauce hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Cook the tagine for an additional 10 minutes if the sauce needs to thicken.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the Jubilant French Chicken Tagine hot and enjoy.
